newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Misr Chemical 95/96 net profit off.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Misr Chemical 95/96 net profit off.

text.p: Misr Chemical Industries net profit for the financial year 1995/96 fell to 20.53 million pounds ($6.04 million) from 29.59 million pounds in the previous year, a company statement published on Thursday showed.
The financial year runs from July 1 to June 30.

The portion allocated to shareholders dropped to 17.46 million pounds in 1995/96 from 20.27 million pounds the previous year, or the equivalent of 1.09 pounds for each of the 16 million shares. Reserves swelled to 97.62 million pounds from 95.35 million in the same period.
Shareholders' equity rose to 165.16 million pounds in 1995/ 96 from 162.98 million pounds in 1994/95.
The company's shares opened at 17.25 pounds on Thursday on the Egyptian stock exchange from Wednesday's close of 16.75 pounds.
The company statement showed that projects under implementation reached 548.69 million pounds in 1995/96, up from 256.04 million pounds the previous year.
